protocol.camera: Scriptable camera at (17,14,26), lookAt (0,1,2), vertical FOV 60; no operator movement.
protocol.player: Single Studio Play client. Server-owned character physics, movement disabled. Fixed controls place the character above or away from the pad; actual falling contact activates it. Wait for grounding before capture.
protocol.lighting: ClockTime 14, Brightness 2, Ambient and OutdoorAmbient RGB(110,110,110), GlobalShadows false. The server creates identical ground, checkpoint collision geometry, path and course pylons for every variant.
protocol.graphics: On the validated macOS Studio 0.739 setup, use Rendering > Graphics Mode OpenGL and restart Studio: Metal returned solid-magenta Play screenshots. Set EditQualityLevel to Level21 and require the Play client's QualityLevel to report Level21. This Studio build resets QualityLevel when Play starts; an Edit Command Bar assignment does not establish Play quality. Check the Client render.settings event in the trial trace; unavailable settings or deviations leave capture review incomplete. Keep the same renderer and quality across the corpus. Preserve original acquired bytes.
protocol.action: The fixed gui_button plan collects three ordered states. BasaltEvalCaptureControls occupies only the top 9% of the native viewport. Mask that strip for judging after human verification; preserve all product UI. No resizing or required resolution. Use Run capture from the connected Edit plugin; do not click controls manually during a trial.
protocol.limitations: Four authored visual variants, including one intended feedback-suppression contrast, with identical mechanic logic, all development-only. These are state samples, not video; no elapsed duration, response latency, continuous feel, transfer or calibration claim. Camera/framing and native dimensions must be consistent and human-reviewed. Existing draft rubric wording is reused without a new human approval. Hold inference until the expert approves the rubric and clean evidence.
